messages:
Alex G.: putting up a canary for model v2 at 5% traffic. will wire dashboards and notify SRE if anything spikes. :rocket:

Maria T.: +1. can we add guards for error rate and latency? e.g. abort if error_rate increases >0.5pp or p95 latency increases >150ms vs baseline.

Alex G.: draft rollout config i was thinking to post to API:
```
{
  "id": "model-v2-canary",
  "traffic": {"baseline":95, "canary":5},
  "guards": {"error_rate_delta":0.005, "p95_latency_ms":150},
  "evaluation_window_seconds":900
}
```

Kevin L.: minor: error_rate_delta as absolute pp is confusing. we use relative percent elsewhere. suggest "error_rate_relative_pct": 10 (means 10% relative increase). also include which baseline window to compare to.

Alex G.: good point. updating. new plan:
```
{
  "id": "model-v2-canary",
  "traffic_split": {"baseline":95, "canary":5},
  "guards": {"error_rate_relative_pct":10, "p95_latency_ms":150},
  "baseline_window": 86400,
  "canary_window": 900
}
```

sre-bot: rollout started: model-v2-canary (id=rollout_20240405_42) — dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/rollout_20240405_42 :eyes: 

June S.: dashboard request: add drilldowns so we can pivot by route, customer_tier, and model_shard. need side-by-side canary vs baseline with CI bands. also link to traces/logs for top offenders.

Sam P.: watch out for baseline vs canary window mismatch — our baseline uses 24h rolling and canary is 15m. the system needs to normalize for traffic volume and seasonality.

Maria T.: also exclude internal/dev traffic by default (filter on env != "staging") and surface cohort comparisons (new users vs returning)

Alex G.: UX plan for console: per-rollout overview cards (p50/p95/error_rate/delta), a drilldown panel, raw request sample feed, and an "explain" button that opens traces and recent errors. guards evaluated every 60s; if guard tripped -> auto-rollback + notify channel and create incident ticket.

Kevin L.: alerting tie-in: alerts should reference rollout_id and be auto-snoozed on rollback/complete. also include a linkable runbook snippet in the alert payload.

Alex G.: action items: 1) API: accept relative delta + baseline/canary windows (KEVIN) 2) Console: add drilldowns and cohort filters (JUNE) 3) Telemetry: ensure rollouts emit rollout_id in all metrics/spans (SAM) 4) SRE: wire auto-rollback + incident creation (MARIA). ETA: EOD tomorrow for API change, console PR by Wed.

sre-bot: smoke tests passed on canary v2 (all checks green). continuing to monitor. :thumbsup:

Maria T.: logging one more ask — make the canary drilldown expose request examples (prompt+response) redacted for PII so product can do manual quality checks.

Alex G.: noted. will add redact pipeline and sampling.

June S.: thanks — once console PR lands i can add the grafana/growthdash templates for product and support.

Kevin L.: +1. keep throttles conservative when rolling to higher percentages; prefer step increases (5 -> 20 -> 50) with manual approval at 50%.

Alex G.: agreed. iterative ramp with manual gate at 50%. will post rollout plan in #eng-releases when ready.

sre-bot: update: 5% -> 20% traffic shift scheduled in 30m. :calendar:

Alex G.: thanks all, ping me here if you see anything odd. will follow up with PR links and dashboard screenshots.
